channelTitle: Grandma June always kept a jug of this cloudy water in the icebox
hook: Grandma June always kept a jug of this cloudy, lemony water in the icebox for whenever a tummy felt fussy.
remedy: Barley simmered in water and strained is an old English home remedy, a plain, gentle drink families made for a fussy, unsettled stomach long before flavored electrolyte drinks existed.
steps: Simmer a quarter cup of pearl barley in four cups of water for about 30 minutes
Strain out the barley, keeping the cloudy water
Stir in a little honey and a squeeze of lemon, then sip warm or chilled
caution: Barley contains gluten, so this isn't suitable if you have celiac disease or a gluten sensitivity. Honey isn't for babies under one year old.
cta: Did your family ever make barley water, or is this the first you're hearing of it? Let Grandma June know.
